explanation: The campaign’s own lead places it after the accord in one clause: it "is an extension of the war on drugs and developed after the Colombian peace process of 2016." That is as far as the article goes. It names the accord as what the campaign developed after and argues no mechanism for it, so this edge takes the weakest of the five types and the confidence is `probable`. `enabled` says the earlier record made room for the later one. The source states the order of the two and the reader can see where the argument stops. Rule 22 refuses `consensus` on a Wikipedia citation in any case.
